name: 60096 · Winthrop Hbr, IL
findings: ZIP 60096 (Winthrop Hbr) has 21 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60096 (Winthrop Hbr) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
